drafts.subject: Re: Speaking invitation - AgentConf 2026 (Oct 14-15, Berlin)
drafts.message:
Dear Elena,

Thank you for the kind invitation to speak at AgentConf 2026. We're honored to be considered, and we would be delighted to accept.

Our team member James Park will deliver the talk on Jac and the walker model. James is one of our core contributors and has deep expertise in the agentic programming model — he'll be a great fit for the 30-minute slot.

Could you share any additional logistics details (e.g., submission deadlines for slides, A/V setup, rehearsal schedule)? We're happy to accommodate your planning timeline.

We also note and appreciate that travel and accommodation are covered. Please let us know what information you need from James (passport details, dietary preferences, etc.) and we'll get that over promptly.

Looking forward to a great conference in Berlin!

Best regards,
Jaseci Impact Team
Jaseci
